decisions.rationale: Clearest three-quarter view (depth for TRELLIS), posts at both ends and a straight top; a is nearly frontal and c has a ragged top course.
Cooked 5,910 triangles, 462 KB; 1.23 m tall, 3.2 m long against a gable wall. Log ends and bark read at gameplay distance; albedoGain 2.0 after r1 came out about 2x dark.
Stacked against cottage gables: fits its 1.0 x 3.2 m box, no gaps to the wall in the default camera. Limitation: the log ends are soft, not individually modelled.
